name: Chronicler’s Scroll
body:
You are a master of scribing scrolls and can grant them additional bonuses.

Prerequisite(s): Scribe Scroll, Profession (scribe) 10 ranks, 5th-level chronicler

Benefit: Whenever you scribe a scroll using the scribe scroll feat, you can modify the scroll with any one of the following benefits: increase the DC to resist the spell on the scroll by 1; or increase the duration of a spell measured in rounds or rounds per caster level by 1 round per 2 levels of chronicler you possess; or calculate the numerical effects of the spell (other than duration) which are dependent on caster level by adding one third of your chronicler level to your caster level. These benefits only work if you use the scroll yourself, and the monetary value of the scroll does not increase.
